headline: SiteGuard flaw exploited; ConnectWise cuts Cloud Backup access
standfirst: Active exploitation of a command injection flaw in a web application firewall leads today's briefing, alongside a supply-chain breach that reached Microsoft 365 tenants and a shifting security hiring market.
bodyMarkdown:
## Actively exploited

Attackers are exploiting an OS command injection flaw in SiteGuard Server Edition to run commands as root or SYSTEM on affected servers [[s1]]. No CVE ID, affected versions or patch guidance were supplied. Analysis: severity is unstated, so priority rests on reported active exploitation rather than any scoring signal.

## Breaches

ConnectWise shut off customer access to its Cloud Backup service after attackers accessed application identities and compromised Microsoft 365 tenants [[s4]]. The excerpt does not say how those identities were obtained or how many tenants were affected.

## Industry

US cybersecurity job postings fell 26% while demand for AI security engineers rose, according to a jobs report [[s2]]. No breakdown by role or region was supplied.
